evals.prompt: Emby: I called POST /Library/VirtualFolders/Paths?name=Home%20videos&path=D:\Media and got HTTP 500 'Unrecognized Guid format'. What's wrong, and what's the exact corrected call?
evals.expected_output: Cause: the endpoint has no name-based lookup — it calls GetItemById on whatever id is passed, so name= throws 'Unrecognized Guid format' (HTTP 500). Fix: resolve the library's Guid (32-hex, from GET /Library/VirtualFolders — not the decimal ItemId) and call .../Paths?id=<Guid>&path=<path>&refreshLibrary=true. May note auth (api_key query param or X-Emby-Token header) and that embyserver.txt carries the real stack trace.

evals.prompt: Sonarr downloads complete but land in SABnzbd's default folder instead of my 'TV' category. Where do I look, and what's the likely cause?
evals.expected_output: Category-string chain: SABnzbd force-lowercases category identifiers (TV -> tv), Sonarr's download-client tvCategory must equal the stored lowercase string, and Prowlarr's clientCategory mapping lives on a separate top-level categories field (not .fields). Mismatch fails silently — no error anywhere, the job just lands at the default/wrong category, so re-reading config is not enough; check the SABnzbd history entry's category and storage path (or Find-ArrJob) for where it actually landed.

evals.prompt: Where does Emby keep logs and config, what process and port does it run on, and how do I get an API key?
evals.expected_output: Logs: %AppData%\Emby-Server\programdata\logs\embyserver.txt; config: %AppData%\Emby-Server\programdata\config\ (system.xml; no API key is stored on disk). Process EmbyServer plus the embytray helper; default port 8096. API key: mint in Dashboard -> Advanced -> API Keys, or trade credentials via POST /Users/AuthenticateByName. Tail the log on a 500 instead of guessing request shape.
